name: AetherBuilder
changelog: New: Customizable Splash Screen & Pre-loader Settings in Site Settings (⚙️) — full control over loading title, sub-caption, toggle visibility, and live mini-preview
Fix: Resolved black screen bug in Admin Studio & Public View caused by loader z-index conflicts; initial loader auto-dismisses immediately
Fix: Added Argon2 login modal loader dismissal ensuring security prompts are always visible above any overlay
Fix: Resilient activeData fallback to default templates preventing blank canvas on fresh or unseeded installations
Fix: Synchronized AddonManager.init with api.php get_addons response format
Fix: Populated missing sections in data/templates.json for SaaS and Portfolio starter templates
Security & Privacy: Dedicated Developer Tab (🔒 Developer) protected by separate WebAssembly Argon2id cryptographic master gate
Security: Hidden Remote Add-on Feed URL completely from the public Add-on Store modal, managed exclusively in Developer Hub
New: Free Template Store (📋 Templates) featuring 100% free layouts with auto-detected required add-ons and 1-click auto-install
New: Developer Hub management controls for remote feed synchronization, master testing key generation, and canvas-to-template conversion
Fix: Unparsed Handlebars template tags in Add-on Store live previews resolved with scope-aware compiler
New: Admin Portal & Argon2 Login Gate add-on widget with customizable styles and WebAssembly Argon2id verification
Fix: Revisions & 1-Click Rollback system automatically archiving immutable site snapshots on Publish Live
Fix: Automated canvas template backup to Media Library (assets/uploads/template_live_canvas.json) on every Publish Live
Fix: Cross-device admin synchronization — automatically loads latest published canvas from server/media
Fix: Zero top padding in desktop editor mode so header section is 100% flush at the top with 0px space
Fix: Update modal Install Update button pinned in sticky footer
Fix: Topbar responsive layout on 1366x768 screens — all tool icons protected from squishing
Fix: Add Section modal real-time search & filter with instant pill tabs
New: Mobile-friendly admin studio with slide-over drawer sidebar
New: Custom Live Chat Add-on (Tawk.to, Crisp, WhatsApp float, custom embed)
New: Contact & Hire Me Add-on (EmailJS, Viber, WhatsApp, Phone)
New: Smart non-destructive addon merger on updates
